description: Fail-closed execution trust policy. Reviewed invocation contracts are trusted; every other registry export is discovery-only until its semantics are reviewed.

agent_exec.rationale: Legacy transaction, recovery, and direct argv execution helpers remain outside the reviewed broker until per-command argument contracts replace their broad executable policy.

agent_loop.rationale: The current loop implementation simulates provider work and is not a trusted agent runtime.

orchestrate.rationale: The current implementation is host-specific and may use tmux, Redis, processes, and mutable coordination state.

otel.rationale: Telemetry initialization and export require explicit endpoint, data, and network contracts before trusted execution.
